note: This artifact proves a live inference call and preserves its candidate for comparison. It is never feature authority and never establishes coverage.

narrative.iNeed: successful query console HTTP requests (index-info, query, snippet) to return well-formed JSON responses with proper headers
narrative.soThat: the query console client can consistently ingest structured metadata, query results, and source code snippets

scenarios.title: Serialize index information payload
given: a query console server receiving a request for index info
when: the index metadata is requested via the index-info handler
then: the server returns a 200 HTTP response with a JSON-serialized index summary payload and content headers
scenarios.observableResult: The HTTP client receives a 200 OK status with application/json headers and a JSON object containing index statistics.
scenarios.conformanceSignal: Response body is valid JSON with coverage and count statistics, and Content-Type is application/json; charset=utf-8.

scenarios.title: Serialize relational query result receipt
given: a query console server receiving a valid relational query request
when: the query command executes successfully against the index
then: the server returns a 200 HTTP response with the JSON-serialized query execution receipt
scenarios.observableResult: The HTTP client receives a 200 OK status containing the serialized relational query receipt.
scenarios.conformanceSignal: Response body is valid JSON representing the query receipt, with matching Content-Length and Content-Type headers.

scenarios.title: Serialize source code snippet payload
given: a query console server receiving a request for a workspace source snippet
when: the requested file and line range are successfully extracted
then: the server returns a 200 HTTP response with the JSON-serialized snippet payload
scenarios.observableResult: The HTTP client receives a 200 OK status with a JSON object containing source code lines and context.
scenarios.conformanceSignal: Response body is valid JSON containing line objects with hit indicators and availability status.

obligations.statement: Serialize index metadata and summary counts into a JSON HTTP response.
Serialize query execution receipts into a JSON HTTP response.
Serialize extracted source line snippets into a JSON HTTP response.

queryEvidence.commandText: SELECT bm.mechanic AS mechanic, bm.modulePath AS modulePath, sym.name AS symbolName, sr.startLine AS startLine, sr.endLine AS endLine FROM bodyMechanics bm JOIN sourceReferences sr ON bm.sourceReferenceId = sr.referenceId LEFT JOIN symbols sym ON bm.fromSymbolId = sym.symbolId WHERE bm.mechanic = 'serialization' AND bm.modulePath = 'serves-query-console.runtime.impl.mjs' AND sym.name IN ('handleIndexInfo', 'handleQuery', 'handleSnippet') ORDER BY sr.startLine

modelAssessment.rationale: The grounded cluster covers successful JSON response serialization across the three query console handlers (handleIndexInfo, handleQuery, and handleSnippet) in src/console/serves-query-console.runtime.impl.mjs. Scenarios directly map these handlers to JSON serialization obligations.
